% Pattern: number/within. \newtheorem of amsart, without the amsthm package,
% with an empty counter in the brackets prints the plain number, as 1. Seen in
% the gold pilot (set X).
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1
% want lemma-1 statement/lemma 2
% want theorem-2 statement/theorem 3
\documentclass{amsart}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}[]
\newtheorem{lemma}[theorem]{Lemma}
\begin{document}
\section{One}
\begin{theorem} Every compact space is bounded. \end{theorem}
\begin{lemma} Every finite space is compact. \end{lemma}
\section{Two}
\begin{theorem} Every finite space is bounded. \end{theorem}
\end{document}
